description: Share a keyboard, mouse and clipboard between Windows and Linux computers.
notes: Run kbshare to open first-run setup, or kbshare-config to edit configuration.
Settings, certificates, trust and logs are preserved in the Scoop persist/kbshare/data directory.
Exit kbshare from its tray menu before updating.
pre_install: @('@echo off', 'if "%~1"=="" (', '    start "" "%~dp0kbshare.exe" --config "%~dp0data\config.json"', ') else (', '    start "" "%~dp0kbshare.exe" %*', ')') | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$dir\kbshare.cmd" -Encoding ascii

@('@echo off', 'if "%~1"=="" (', '    start "" "%~dp0kbshare-config.exe" "%~dp0data\config.json" kbshare', ') else (', '    start "" "%~dp0kbshare-config.exe" %*', ')') | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$dir\kbshare-config.cmd" -Encoding ascii
